facts.fact: A deal record drawn from Novo Jornal and Lusa reporting states that a presidential dispatch dated January 2017 selected CEIEC for a USD 243 million supply and technical-support contract with the Ministry of Justice and Human Rights as recipient, to implement a platform covering birth and death registration, identity-card issuance and the criminal register, on a commercial credit line to be negotiated with a Chinese financial institution.
facts.system: Plataforma de Gestão Integrada da Identificação Civil e Criminal

systems.system: Plataforma de Gestão Integrada da Identificação Civil e Criminal
systems.country_label: Plataforma de Gestão Integrada da Identificação Civil e Criminal
systems.platform: supplied by China National Electronics Import & Export Corporation (CEIEC)
systems.owner: Ministério da Justiça e dos Direitos Humanos, as recipient of the contract
systems.tiers: not stated; a contract approved in January 2017, not a system in use

note: The same dispatch as document 73, from a deal record of the same news report; it adds nothing on where or how a birth or death is entered. Classed civil because the record says the platform covers birth and death registration; it also covers identity cards and the criminal register, and the parent may prefer identity.
